name: DOHMH School Cafeteria Inspections (2020-Present)
description:
This dataset contains records from New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene inspections of school cafeterias from 2020 onward. Each row represents a single inspection, linking a school (identified by name, address, borough, and geographic identifiers such as latitude, longitude, census tract, community board, and council district) to the date of inspection and any violations found. Violation entries include a code, a description, and a level, along with the permittee and site type. The sample covers 5,000 rows across 25 columns.

The data can be used to track cafeteria inspection outcomes over time, compare conditions across boroughs or districts, identify schools or areas with recurring violations, and map inspection results geographically. It may also support public health research, school food safety monitoring, and transparency reporting for parents and school communities.
